dict.string: nox reads the current tab URL from your browser when you press ⌥⌘V so it can download the video you're watching.
nox reads your upcoming events to show a "next meeting" pill in the notch and surface the join link.
nox shows your next meeting in the notch pill so you can see it without opening Calendar.
nox hides transient pills (charging, screenshots, Bluetooth) while you're in a Focus or Do Not Disturb mode.
nox dictates your voice into the active app. Audio is sent to your configured transcription provider (Groq by default) and is not stored or retained.
